messages:
Sam (CEO): Quick Friday pulse — short and actionable. 3 things: 1) Launch readiness for Private GA, 2) reliability snapshot, 3) a small data-retention policy tweak. TL;DR: we’re green to GA if product and legal finish checklist early next week. :rocket:
Marta (VP Product): Thanks — high level plan? Do we have a frozen checklist and owner for each item?
Riley (Head of Eng): Eng readiness: performance targets met on staging: P50 ~ 30ms, P95 ~ 180ms for 8k contexts with our batching config. Load test replay passed 95% of targets. We still have one perf regression in kv-cache under concurrent writes — patch in review. :wrench:
Sam (CEO): Awesome on perf. Riley — can we get the kv patch merged by Monday morning? Can you call out risk if not?
Riley (Head of Eng): Yep. If not merged, risk = slight P95 spike under sustained bursts; mitigation = temporary throttle + fallback to slightly lower-capacity model variant. Plan B tested in canary.
Jin (Head of Ops): Infra/ops note: Dedicated capacity nodes are ready for GA. Autoscale policies tuned for expected traffic curve. We’ll enable stricter quotas during first 72h to protect latency. Also prepping runbook for onsite support during launch window.
Asha (Head of CS): CS: top 3 GA customers are aligned with our current SLA. We're scheduling customer onboarding calls next week. Also flagging that a couple of early customers asked about data retention and deletion assurances.
Sam (CEO): That leads to policy change: small update to default hosted data-retention — default retention now 90 days (was 180) for new signups unless account sets a custom policy. This is to reduce legal risk and storage costs. Existing customers unaffected unless they opt in. Legal + Product will publish wording.
Marta (VP Product): Noted. Action: Marta to publish GA checklist + policy wording by Mon 10am PT. Can @Legal review same day?
Theo (Finance): Quick finance snapshot: projected incremental ARR from GA customers is $420k in Q1 post-GA (conservative). Cost delta from shorter retention is -8% storage spend on hosted. Will send a short note with modeled sensitivity.
Sam (CEO): Thanks @Theo. Also a quick ops ask: reduce default log retention in console telemetry to 30 days for new orgs. Jin, can you coordinate?
Jin (Head of Ops): Will do. Patch + admin notice scheduled for Monday deploy window.
DeployBot: Deploy queued: branch=release/private-ga, env=staging -> canary. Triggered by Riley. (deploy id: db-2026-0910-7).
Asha (Head of CS): One more customer ask — can we offer a canned DPA summary for security teams? I can draft a short template by Tuesday.
Marta (VP Product): Great — add DPA summary to GA docs. Also we should highlight our rollback/fallback plan in the public release notes.
Sam (CEO): Top-level asks (owners): 1) Marta — publish GA checklist + policy wording (Mon 10am). 2) Riley — merge kv-cache patch & validate canary (Mon AM). 3) Jin — enable quotas and telemetry retention change (Mon deploy). 4) Asha — DPA summary draft (Tue). 5) Theo — send finance sensitivity note (Mon). Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
Marta (VP Product): :white_check_mark: will confirm Monday.
Riley (Head of Eng): :white_check_mark: (pv patched locally — pushing PR now).
Jin (Head of Ops): :white_check_mark: on scheduling.
Theo (Finance): :thumbsup: sending note.
Asha (Head of CS): :spiral_note_pad: drafting DPA.
Sam (CEO): Thanks team — small ask to execs: keep launch communications short. We’ll do a 15m sync Monday to confirm green/red. Enjoy the weekend, recharge.
Marta (VP Product): Short sync added to calendar: Mon 09:00 PT. Agenda: checklist review, kv patch status, legal wording.
Riley (Head of Eng): Will be there.
Asha (Head of CS): Adding customer readiness update slot.
Sam (CEO): Closing note: big thanks — this launch matters for our Dedicated & Private motion. Keep eyes on Slack #incidents and #eng-oncall if anything pops. :v:
Jin (Head of Ops): FYI — I’ll post runbook link in this thread once done.
DeployBot: Canary deploy started: canary-3 -> 3 nodes. Monitoring metrics posted to console.
